prompt_style: Original painterly high-fantasy strategy-game overworld landmark, isometric three-quarter view from slightly above, compact non-color-dependent silhouette for 48x48 readability, transparent background, centered isolated object, no people, text, logos, border, UI, or reference to protected game art.
runtime_pipeline: Each transparent 1254x1254 generated master is trimmed, proportionally reduced inside a 44x44 box, centered on a transparent 48x48 cell, and appended left-to-right into one 288x48 runtime atlas. Generated masters remain source-only and art/overworld/source is excluded from Linux and Windows release packages.

assets.prompt_subject: Squat riveted river powder gate, diagonal broken chain boom, tall wrapped mourning sail, two capped powder kegs, and square hooded signal lantern.
assets.non_color_identity: The diagonal chain boom crosses a low fortified base while a single tall wrapped sail produces an uneven vertical peak.

assets.prompt_subject: Broad brass levy gauge tower in a woven marsh-reed drum ring, oversized projecting pressure needle, forked reed-caller horn, and chained contract plates.
assets.non_color_identity: An oversized diagonal gauge needle projects from a broad round tower beneath a wide fork of paired reed horns.

assets.prompt_subject: Seven narrow mirror-glass facets in an asymmetric fan inside a living root arch, suspended split prism, and low root-grown witness bench.
assets.non_color_identity: Seven separate pointed facets fan around one suspended center shard inside a branching circular root frame.

assets.prompt_subject: Hooked living bolt-tree bent around a square masonry beacon lock, three aimed seed-bolt pods, narrow fire slot, and root-woven crank.
assets.non_color_identity: A bent hooked trunk grows from a square lock and divides into three widely aimed pointed seed-pod arms.

assets.prompt_subject: Heavy black-brass assay gauge over a triangular sun-prism impound, long counterweight arm, three taut noonwires, and shallow quench tray.
assets.non_color_identity: A long horizontal counterweight beam overhangs a large trapped triangular prism inside a rigid three-post assay frame.

assets.prompt_subject: Tall curved tidehook crane lifting a half-submerged reed bell from a broken skiff cradle, forked dragnet, three memory-salt floats, and funeral lamp.
assets.non_color_identity: A single crescent crane curves over one suspended bell while a ragged side net and three round floats pull the silhouette left.
